entities.title: Replays
entities.summary: A reign replays from its seed and keys to the score the browser saw, and keys that don't play exactly one whole reign are refused.
criteria: 200 recorded reigns replay to the same score, months and fate
One key too few or too many is refused; another seed fails or scores its own reign

checks.symbol: a replay from the seed and the keys gives the same score
a replay is refused when the keys don't play exactly one whole reign

entities.details: submitScore's own refusals (a bad id, keys or name; an unknown, used or expired seed) and the claim of the seed have no automated check.

entities.title: The scores page
entities.summary: The web page lists reigns, escapes names and carries the site's footer.
criteria: Each reign's rank, name, score, months and fate are listed
The site's footer links are there

checks.symbol: the high-score web page lists the reigns, escapes names, and carries the site's footer

entities.title: Sign-in
entities.summary: The page and the score API need a sign-in.
criteria: Someone signed out is sent to sign in, and back
The page is served privately to anyone signed in
A new game or a score needs a sign-in, and an unreachable login service counts as signed out

checks.symbol: sign-in: the game's page sends someone signed out to sign in, and back
sign-in: the page is served to anyone signed in, privately
sign-in: a new game or a score needs a sign-in; the login service out of reach is signed out
